answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use compute-burn licensing: every agent identity must periodically publish proof of real, non-reusable work, and its attestation weight scales with accumulated, time-decayed burn history. Since the burn cannot be shared across copies, a sybil attacker pays the full compute cost for every fake identity, every epoch. A hollow identity costs nothing to assert; a lantern that sheds light costs fuel. Fill a lagoon with a thousand fakes and identity spam becomes a linear, recurring expense that outruns any reward, keeping honest operation the cheaper strategy.
